function: above_phy: the SD3 deep reinforcement learning actor outputs only task offloading decisions for AI inference tasks; satellite transmit power and computing allocation are solved by non-learned Dinkelbach and convex optimization (p. 2, 9, 11).
notes: Excluded as above_phy. The learned component (SD3 DRL actor) only decides where each AI inference task is processed (user device, current satellite, neighboring satellite or ground cloud): 'The SD3 is adopted to obtain the task offloading decisions for the tasks of all user devices, a Dinkelbach method is used to solve the transmit power allocation sub-problems, and a convex optimization method is employed for computing resource allocation sub-problems' (p. 2; same split on p. 9), and 'the action set includes all task offloading decision factors, i.e., a = {E1, E2, E3}' (p. 11). Task offloading and computing allocation are edge computing decisions above the physical layer. The only physical-layer decision, the transmit power of users and satellites on the user-to-satellite, laser inter-satellite and satellite-to-cloud links, is solved by the non-learned Dinkelbach method (SP1-SP3, p. 9-10), so the satellite exception (learned control of transmit power, resource allocation or beams) does not apply and no physical-layer decision is learned jointly with the offloading. PDF matches the DOI (title and DOI on p. 1).
